The diagram shows a wiring schematic for a 5-20P cordset. It includes a PY50 Type K T/C thermocouple, a customer-furnished pyrometer, a 30A relay (TF17) with a 120V coil, a pilot light (MS8), and a power switch (SW5). The power requirements are listed as 120 volts, 1 phase, 50/60 hertz, 20 amps, and 2400 watts. Wire sizes are specified as #14 AWG.
